_definitions.split_error: per index or pool-sensitivity variant, printed draw (draw 0): per-N Monte Carlo SE of the mean over the 50 random splits (SD of the per-split Spearman-Brown values / sqrt(50)), its maximum, the per-split values, and per crossing the point value, the delta-method split SE (split_se_delta) and the SD, share reaching and 2.5th / 97.5th percentiles over 2,000 resamples of the per-split values within each N; frozen_grid_* = the same on the pre-specified grid N = 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200
_definitions.draw_curves: per curve (random_<index>, temporal_<index>, icc_<index>): draw 0 value, mean and SD over the K further subsample draws, and the value in each further draw
_definitions.draw_crossings: <halves>_<index>_<grid>_<level>: over the K further draws, median and 2.5th / 97.5th percentiles (a draw that never reaches the level within 200 ranked above 200), mean and SD only when every draw reaches the level, share reaching within 200, draw 0 value, crossing of the mean curve, share of draws below the draw 0 value, share above 31 (S2, .70)
_definitions.kept_shares: per resolution index: share of students with both halves defined (random halves, mean over the 50 splits; temporal halves), share with half A undefined, share undefined on the full N-answer set; draw 0 and mean / SD over the further draws
_definitions.draw_quantities: bias r(20), bias r(15) interpolated between N = 10 and 20, and (S2) the replication criteria, per further draw; informational
_definitions.regression_max_abs_diff: draw 0 against results/r2_A.json (curves, split SE, pool-sensitivity curves, full-set undefined shares) and results/r1_B_parts (ICC curve)
_definitions.index names: bias, brier, gamma, auroc (tie convention), auroc_pr (plan rule), conf, acc, bias_g and brier_g (guess-corrected coding c' = .25 + .75 c)
